reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a Bilateral Senior Loan of up to EUR 150 million to Pekao Leasing sp. z o.o. ("Pekao Leasing", "The Company") for sub-loans and leases to finance Polish corporates and MSMEs in compliance with the Policy Statement for the Resilience and Livelihoods Framework, a EUR 2 billion package to support Ukraine and other affected countries. The Project will enhance the lending capacity of Pekao Leasing S.A. and will be channelled for on-lending to businesses in Poland that have been directly or indirectly affected by economic consequences of the war on Ukraine through supply-chain disruptions and other shocks, with the ultimate goal of preserving livelihoods in the country. Moreover, the Project will contribute towards building a green economy by facilitating the expansion of energy efficiency, resource efficiency, renewable energy, water efficiency and waste minimisation investments, while supporting positive demonstration effects of green projects for MSMEs.
